name: Resize Image
label: Scale by pixel or ratio
description: Change image dimensions for JPG, PNG, and WebP. Fit inside custom widths and heights without distortion.
how: Select a JPG, PNG, or WebP image or paste from clipboard (Ctrl+V).
Enter width and height, side-by-side. Keep proportions checked to prevent distortion.
Download your resized image or send it directly to another tool.
faq: Keeping proportions scales the image to fit inside your target dimensions without stretching. Width and height are positioned side-by-side for quick editing.

name: Compress Image
label: Reduce file size in KB
description: Reduce JPG and WebP file size without losing quality. Adjust quality, scale dimensions, or set a target KB.
how: Select a JPG, PNG, or WebP image.
Adjust quality slider at the top, dimension scale below, or set a target KB.
Download your compressed image with full before-and-after size stats.
faq: Quality is placed first for quick tuning. If a file cannot reach a low target like 50 KB, reduce the dimension scale percentage proportionally while keeping details crisp.

name: Crop & Rotate
label: Trim, rotate & straighten
description: Crop photos to square or widescreen ratios, rotate in 90-degree steps, flip, and straighten with instant preview.
how: Select an image or press Ctrl+V to paste a screenshot.
Rotate 90°, flip horizontally, or select an aspect ratio crop (Square, 4:3, 16:9).
Download your cropped, straightened image or send it to compress.
faq: Cropping trims outer edges cleanly and rotation updates pixel layout directly without sending images to any server.

name: Combine Images
label: Join screenshots & photos
description: Join multiple pictures together vertically into a continuous screenshot or horizontally side-by-side with custom spacing.
how: Select two or more images and arrange their sequence with the arrow buttons.
Choose vertical stacking for chats/receipts or horizontal for side-by-side comparisons.
Download your combined single image.
faq: Vertical stacking automatically matches widths or centers panels. You can customize the gap and background color (white, transparent, or dark).

name: Make Square (No Crop)
label: Fit 1:1 without cropping
description: Fit rectangular photos into a 1:1 square canvas without cutting off faces or text, using blurred borders or solid colors.
how: Select any landscape or portrait photo.
Choose a background style: soft blurred image background, solid white, or black.
Download your 1:1 square image ready for profile avatars and social feeds.
faq: Square-only avatars often cut off sides of wide photos. This tool fits your entire photo inside the square while filling the border aesthetic cleanly.

name: Photo Size for Forms
label: Passports, visas & IDs
description: Prepare photos for visa applications, government portals, and online forms with exact dimensions and strict KB limits.
how: Select your portrait or ID photo.
Choose a standard preset (US Visa 600×600, Passport 2×2 in, ID photo) or enter custom specs.
Download your compliant photo with a live requirements checklist.
faq: Government and job portals frequently reject files over 100 KB–240 KB or incorrect aspect ratios. This tool handles both dimensions and compression in a single verified step.

name: Convert Image
label: Convert JPG, PNG & WebP
description: Quickly convert pictures between JPG, PNG, and WebP formats with instant preview.
how: Select a JPG, PNG, or WebP image.
Choose your desired output format.
Download your converted file or send it to compress.
faq: PNG and WebP support transparency. Converting transparent images to JPG replaces the transparent background with clean white.

name: Merge PDF
label: Combine multiple PDFs
description: Combine multiple PDF documents into a single clean file in any order you choose.
how: Select two or more PDF files.
Use the arrow buttons to arrange page order.
Download your combined PDF.
faq: Original vector graphics and text quality are completely preserved. Encrypted PDFs must be unlocked before merging.

name: Organize PDF
label: Rearrange & extract pages
description: Extract, reorder, or delete pages from your PDF with a simple custom page sequence.
how: Select a PDF file to see its page count.
Enter a page sequence like 3, 1-2, 5 to sort or extract sheets.
Download your organized PDF.
faq: Use commas and ranges. For example, 1-3 keeps pages 1 to 3, while 3-1 reverses them. Pages you omit are deleted.

name: Images to PDF
label: Turn photos into PDF
description: Convert collections of photos and documents into a clean PDF booklet with A4 or Letter formatting.
how: Select your photos and arrange their order.
Choose page layout: A4, US Letter, or fit to image size.
Download your PDF document.
faq: Images scale cleanly to fit page margins without cropping. Text inside photos remains an image; OCR is not performed.
